lines: lodash, 19,595 B on the sharerenamer-main page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
core-js, 19,466 B on the sharerenamer-main page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (51 packages, 343 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
